policies.label: 60 FPS / Custom FPS
policies.currentBehavior: Changes Runtime FrameLoop step cadence. 0 is a special display-refresh-synchronized simulation mode; positive values set currentStepTime=1000/fps.
hiddenEffects: changes Runtime._step cadence
changes currentStepTime used by sequencer and I/O timing
changes monitor/hat evaluation frequency
does not merely change presentation refresh
validationDebt: Advanced Settings accepts any finite number including 0 and negative values
02 fork removed upstream >250 FPS clamp
different UI ingress applies different validation
policies.migration: 30 => scratch-compatible. Other values => explicit legacy custom simulation-rate override with compatibility warning. 0 => quarantined legacy display-synced simulation mode, not a normal FPS choice.

policies.label: 2 OpsPerFrame / Custom OpsPerFrame
policies.currentBehavior: Runs Runtime._step() repeatedly inside one outer FrameLoop step callback before the render callback.
hiddenEffects: multiple logical steps share one outer scheduler interval
0 executes zero logical steps
fractional values produce loop-count behavior rather than a meaningful fractional policy
no OPSSPERFRAME/OPSPERFRAME VM event is consumed by GUI state listener
validationDebt: custom value accepts 0
custom value accepts fractions
negative value is normalized by Runtime but raw negative is dispatched to Redux
no upper bound
project-load event can leave Redux/UI stale
policies.migration: 1 => drop. Non-1 => preserve only as quarantined legacy Scratch-backend compatibility override until corpus proves a safe migration; never expose as normal project setting.

policies.label: Interpolation
policies.currentBehavior: Keeps simulation cadence unchanged and performs requestAnimationFrame presentation interpolation for visible Scratch targets.
hiddenEffects: only x/y, rendered direction, scale and ghost are interpolated
costume changes disable scale/direction interpolation for that frame
Pen/stamp/custom renderer state is not resampled
implementation reads renderer private _allDrawables
validationDebt: no capability/compatibility analyzer
can be combined freely with custom simulation rates and Pen projects
policies.migration: Map to legacy Scratch transform presenter. Native NGVGE interpolation must be per semantic domain and advertise support; unsupported visual domains must fail/degrade explicitly.

policies.label: High Quality Pen
policies.currentBehavior: Globally toggles renderer high-quality mode, raises PenSkin render quality, disables integer rounding for all Drawable positions, and also relaxes Pen size clamping through VM checks.
hiddenEffects: not Pen-only
changes global drawable coordinate rounding
changes Pen size compatibility semantics
device/render-resolution sensitive
validationDebt: label hides global semantic effects
render quality and coordinate/limit semantics are fused
policies.migration: Preserve legacy hq flag only inside Scratch adapter. Native model separates render resolution/quality from numeric coordinate semantics and Pen limits.

policies.label: Skip Offscreen Sprite Rendering
policies.currentBehavior: Skips provably offstage Bitmap/SVG drawables only in the normal default stage draw pass; special query/filter/effect/private-skin paths bypass culling.
hiddenEffects: 02-specific fork addition
stored as project runtimeOptions despite being backend optimization
renderer owns conservative eligibility rules
validationDebt: project persistence incorrectly elevates a backend optimization into portable project semantics
not mirrored by URL state
policies.migration: Ignore as native project semantic. Legacy import may treat it as a non-authoritative renderer hint; do not serialize into NGVGE project source.

policies.label: Infinite Clones
policies.currentBehavior: Changes clone admission from Scratch-compatible 300 to Infinity in the UI toggle; Runtime clonesAvailable compares clone counter against this value.
hiddenEffects: Infinity removes the only configured clone-count budget
resource consumption becomes device-dependent and potentially unbounded
validationDebt: boolean UI cannot express resource budget policy
Infinity is serialized through ExtendedJSON rather than portable JSON semantics
policies.migration: 300 => Scratch-compatible budget. Infinity/non-default => explicit legacy clone-budget override with warning and host hard ceiling; native projects use finite/adaptive budgets.

policies.label: Remove Fencing
policies.currentBehavior: When disabled, bypasses Scratch position fencing and size clamps and enables offstage collision/touching bounds.
hiddenEffects: changes motion coordinates
changes sprite size admissible range
changes touching/collision behavior outside stage
validationDebt: presented as a generic limit toggle despite modifying three compatibility semantics
policies.migration: Keep exact legacy value only in Scratch Compatibility Adapter. Native NGVGE Node/Scene geometry must not inherit Scratch fencing semantics.

policies.label: Remove Miscellaneous Limits
policies.currentBehavior: One flag controls unrelated Scratch/TurboWarp behaviors across sound, Pen, Music and mouse input.
hiddenEffects: sound effect range clamps
sound effect/volume yield behavior
Pen size clamp
Music concurrency limit
mouse coordinate integer rounding vs three-decimal precision
validationDebt: one boolean crosses multiple semantic domains
cannot express compatibility independently per capability
policies.migration: Legacy false maps to a compatibility bundle preserving all historical effects. Native schema must split sound limits/yield, Pen limits, Music concurrency, input precision, etc.

policies.label: Warp Timer
policies.currentBehavior: Changes compiler-generated warp-loop yielding/isStuck behavior and forces compiler cache reset. Blocks workspace mount independently turns it on in the editor.
hiddenEffects: compiler/backend-specific
not a stable user-owned project setting
editor lifecycle can overwrite user choice
validationDebt: multiple writers
UI suggests user preference although editor mounts can force-enable it
policies.migration: Do not import as project semantic. Use host/runtime safety defaults; expose only diagnostic override in Developer Tools if required.

policies.label: Disable Compiler
policies.currentBehavior: Controls whether new threads attempt compilation and resets all block caches when changed; precompiled scripts may still execute.
hiddenEffects: implementation/backend choice rather than intended project semantics
cache reset side effect
compiled-project load explicitly disables compiler after installing compiled data
validationDebt: normal creator-facing UI exposes backend implementation switch
policies.migration: Never serialize as native project semantics. Runtime chooses backend automatically; debugging override remains hidden/developer scoped.

policies.label: Custom Stage Size
policies.currentBehavior: Changes Runtime stageWidth/stageHeight, renderer stage projection/bounds, shifts monitor coordinates to preserve center-relative placement, and emits STAGE_SIZE_CHANGED.
hiddenEffects: not a runtime tuning knob
affects coordinate space and project geometry
collaboration has another direct stage-size writer
validationDebt: settings input max=1024
URL parser allows up to 4096
Runtime itself has no upper bound beyond positive rounding
multiple ingress use inconsistent validation
policies.migration: Map legacy width/height to versioned project/scene viewport fields. Scratch adapter consumes them; remove from Advanced Runtime settings.

policies.label: Turbo Mode (latent persisted option)
policies.currentBehavior: Sequencer ignores redraw-request yielding while turbo mode is active, allowing more script work before yielding/rendering.
hiddenEffects: not shown in this modal but Store Project Options persists it
changes scheduler/yield behavior rather than just visual speed
validationDebt: hidden member of the same project-options bundle
policies.migration: Preserve only for Scratch compatibility projects that explicitly depend on TurboWarp behavior; do not generalize into NGVGE native scheduler semantics.

policies.label: Store settings in project
policies.currentBehavior: Serializes differing runtime settings into an ExtendedJSON payload hidden in a Stage comment ending with // _twconfig_; VM parses it during whole-project install.
hiddenEffects: mixes execution, presentation, resource, compatibility and project geometry in one unversioned payload
uses user-visible Scratch comment as configuration transport
brands payload as TurboWarp configuration
02 fork adds opsPerFrame/offscreen culling beyond current upstream bundle
validationDebt: no NGVGE schema/version/authority metadata
no conflict-resolution contract against URL/session writers
policies.migration: Parse on import, normalize each field into its owning NGVGE domain, preserve compatibility export only when targeting legacy Scratch/TurboWarp format. Never use _twconfig_ as NGVGE project authority.

findings.summary: OpsPerFrame can be set to 0, causing FrameLoop stepCallback to execute zero Runtime._step calls.
OpsPerFrame custom negative input is normalized to 1 by Runtime but the raw negative value is dispatched to Redux; GUI does not subscribe to OPSPERFRAME_CHANGED.
02 fork comments out TurboWarp's >250 framerate cap, permitting an unbounded high-frequency scheduling request and setImmediate path.
High Quality Pen changes all Drawable position rounding and Pen size clamping in addition to Pen render resolution.
miscLimits is an invalid aggregate policy spanning Sound, Pen, Music and Mouse semantics.
Interpolation is partial presentation resampling only; it cannot provide general 60 Hz compatibility for Pen/custom visual domains.
Offscreen drawable culling is a backend optimization but is persisted as project runtimeOptions.
Custom Stage Size validation disagrees across UI (1024), URL reducer (4096), and Runtime (no equivalent upper bound).
Warp Timer is not stable user authority: Blocks workspace mount forces warpTimer=true independently of the settings checkbox.
Infinite Clones encodes resource policy as Infinity and can remove a host safety budget.
Runtime policy authority is fragmented across modal handlers, Green Flag gestures, URL parameters, project comment parsing, workspace mount, collaboration sync and backend setters.
_twconfig_ mixes unrelated domains in one unversioned Scratch comment and has no explicit precedence resolver against session/URL writers.
URL mirroring is incomplete: OpsPerFrame and offscreen drawable culling can persist in _twconfig_ but are not represented in the URL state mapping.
No compatibility/conflict analyzer prevents semantically hazardous combinations such as custom simulation rate + interpolation + Pen/3D/custom renderer workloads.
Compiler enable/disable is exposed as creator project configuration even though it is an execution backend/debug choice.

RenderingBackend: automatic offscreen culling and other non-semantic optimization
